resources.string: Key heights opens from Observatory on its own page, with separate moment, elevation and date/time columns.
Choose the year from 1900 to 2100. Stable annual calculations retain significant extrema and mid-height passages; single events no longer need a number.
Export Key heights as a CSV spreadsheet or readable TXT table, using the selected formats and location privacy.
Main-view controls use two upper-right rows. Camera, Weather and 0°/90° share the second row; camera mode shows Transparency and Zoom.
Settings, Location forms and export names share more compact input and selection fields, retaining labels, native editing and theme colors.
Tap the Location management title to switch prepared custom values on or off together. Each object retains separate Observatory, Daily path and Key heights scroll positions.
